blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Wednesday said the only way to strengthen the country’s “backdoors” is through better enforcement tools, emphasizing the government is already procuring them. Remulla said this in response to a question on whether the 20th Asean (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime (AMMTC) also tackled tracking the most wanted criminals who leave their respective country to get away from justice.
